# FareedQ.com

Source for the redesigned personal site. A static site with one server-side
endpoint for coaching enquiries.

**Stack:** hand-written HTML generated by one dependency-free Node script,
plus one stylesheet and about 2 kB of progressive-enhancement JavaScript.
No framework, no bundler, no runtime dependencies, no CMS, no external
fonts or CDNs. The only third-party request at runtime is the enquiry
`fetch` to this site's own `/api/inquiry`.

---

## Commands

```sh
node build.mjs            # generate the site into dist/
node build.mjs --check    # fail on broken internal links, bad heading order, missing alt text
node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"   # test the enquiry endpoint (no network)
node --run verify         # build + check + test
python3 -m http.server 4321 --directory dist   # preview locally
```

Nothing to install. `node build.mjs` on a clean checkout produces the whole
site.

---

## Layout

```
build.mjs                 generator: markdown subset, layout, components, checks
src/styles.css            design tokens (:root) and components
site.js                   generated from build.mjs — mobile nav + form behaviour
content/
  site.json               site name, URL, description
  home.json               homepage sections
  coaching.json           coaching page sections
  work-with-me.json       enquiry page, form labels, scope of practice
  pages/about.md          About (frontmatter + prose)
  framework/*.md|.json    the Framework body of knowledge
  essays/*.md             standalone writing
public/                   copied verbatim into dist/
  assets/                 photography (WebP, three widths)
  fonts/                  Archivo variable subset (SIL OFL, see FONTS.md)
functions/api/inquiry.js  Cloudflare Pages Function — the enquiry endpoint
tests/inquiry.test.mjs    endpoint tests
dist/                     GENERATED. Never edit. Not committed.
```

### Editing copy

Prose lives in `content/`, not in components.

- **Homepage / coaching / enquiry page** — `content/*.json`. Each key maps to a
  named section; `build.mjs` renders them in a fixed order. Changing wording
  never requires touching markup.
- **About, Framework pages, Essays** — markdown with a flat YAML-ish
  frontmatter block. Supported syntax is deliberately small: `##`/`###`
  headings, `-` and `1.` lists, `> ` blockquotes, `---` rules, `**bold**`,
  `*italic*`, `` `code` ``, and `[links](https://example.com)`. Anything else is
  treated as plain text.
- **Glossary** — `content/framework/glossary.json`, a list of categories each
  holding terms.

Adding a framework page: drop a `.md` file into `content/framework/` with
`title`, `heading`, `metaTitle`, `metaDescription`, `lede`, `standfirst`, and
`order`. The nav, the framework index, and the sitemap all pick it up
automatically.

## Deployment — GitHub → Cloudflare Pages

The site is designed to be tested on a `*.pages.dev` URL before any DNS for
`fareedq.com` is touched. **Nothing in this repository changes live DNS.**

### 1. Push to GitHub

```sh
cd fareedq-site
git init
git add .
git commit -m "New FareedQ.com"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin git@github.com:<you>/fareedq-site.git
git push -u origin main
```

`dist/` is git-ignored, so CI must build it.

### 2. Create the Pages project

Cloudflare dashboard → **Workers & Pages** → **Create** → **Pages** →
**Connect to Git** → select the repository.

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Framework preset | None |
| Build command | `node build.mjs` |
| Build output directory | `dist` |
| Root directory | `/` (or the repo subfolder, if you use one) |

**Node 20.11 or newer is required** — the test command uses `node --test` with a
glob argument, which Node only expands from 20.11 onward. The build itself runs
on Node 18, but the tests do not, so the floor is 20.11.

Cloudflare Pages' default is Node 22.16.0, which is fine. `.node-version` pins
`22` explicitly so the build does not depend on the platform default changing.

The `functions/` directory is picked up automatically from the repository root;
it must not be moved into `dist/`.

Deploy. The site is now live at `https://<project>.pages.dev` — review it there.

> **First-deploy check:** Cloudflare applies `_redirects` *before* static assets
> ("Redirects are always followed, regardless of whether or not an asset matches
> the incoming request"). `node build.mjs` fails the build if any redirect source
> matches a page the site serves, so a rule cannot silently shadow a real page.
> After deploying, confirm `https://<project>.pages.dev/framework/` loads the
> framework index rather than redirecting.

### 3. Configure the enquiry endpoint

The form posts JSON to `/api/inquiry`, a Pages Function. Without configuration
it returns a clean error and the page tells the visitor to email directly, so
the rest of the site works regardless.

**Required — the site will not send mail without these two:**

| Variable | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `RESEND_API_KEY` | Secret | API key from [resend.com](https://resend.com). Server-side only. |
| `INQUIRY_TO` | Plain text | Where enquiries are delivered, e.g. `hello@fareedq.com`. |

**Optional:**

| Variable | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `INQUIRY_FROM` | Verified sender, e.g. `FareedQ enquiries <enquiries@fareedq.com>`. Defaults to Resend's shared `onboarding@resend.dev`, which **only delivers to the address that owns the Resend account** — fine for a test, not for production. |
| `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` | If set, the form requires and verifies a Cloudflare Turnstile token. |

Set these under **Pages → your project → Settings → Variables and Secrets**, for
both Production and Preview. `RESEND_API_KEY` must be a *secret*; the rest can
be plain text. Redeploy after adding them.

Then, in Resend: add and verify `fareedq.com` as a sending domain (Resend
provides SPF and DKIM records to add at your DNS provider — these are for
outbound mail and are independent of pointing the website at Pages). Once
verified, set `INQUIRY_FROM`. Resend's free tier is sufficient for a site of
this size; check their current limits before relying on a number.

**Optional — durable rate limiting.** The endpoint already limits submissions
per IP, but only per Cloudflare isolate unless you give it storage. To make it
durable: create a KV namespace, bind it to the Pages project as
`INQUIRY_RATE_KV`, and redeploy. Without it the limiter degrades gracefully —
it never blocks a legitimate enquiry.

**Optional — Turnstile.** Bot protection currently relies on a honeypot field,
a minimum fill time, and a link-density heuristic, which is proportionate for a
low-traffic personal site. If spam ever becomes a problem, add a Turnstile
widget to the form in `build.mjs`, pass the token as `turnstileToken`, and set
`TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`. The server-side verification is already implemented.

### 4. Custom domain (when you decide to move)

Only after you are happy with the `pages.dev` version:

1. Pages → your project → **Custom domains** → **Set up a custom domain**.
2. Enter `fareedq.com` and `www.fareedq.com`.
3. If `fareedq.com` is already on Cloudflare, the records are created for you.
   Otherwise you add the CNAME at your registrar.

Because the site is served from a new origin, keep the existing Squarespace
site running until the new one is verified. `public/_redirects` maps every old
Squarespace URL to its new location with a 301, so inbound links and search
results survive the move:

| Old | New |
| --- | --- |
| `/home` | `/` |
| `/about-me` | `/about/` |
| `/services`, `/services-offered` | `/coaching/` |
| `/contact` | `/work-with-me/` |
| `/scope-of-practice` | `/work-with-me/#scope` |
| `/introduction`, `/framework` | `/framework/` |
| `/foundation-polyvagal` | `/framework/polyvagal-theory/` |
| `/new-page-1` | `/framework/somatic-experiencing/` |
| `/glossary` | `/framework/glossary/` |
| `/blog` | `/essays/` |
| `/blog/<slug>` | `/essays/<slug>/` |

Note that `/blog/the-first-principles-of-life-coaching` becomes
`/essays/first-principles-of-life-coaching` (the "the" is dropped).

## Security notes

- No secrets in client-side code. The API key exists only as a Pages
  environment secret, read inside the Function.
- The Function escapes all user input before it enters the email HTML, and
  strips CR/LF from values that reach an email header.
- Nothing is stored: no database, no logging of message bodies. Enquiries exist
  only as email.
- `public/_headers` sets a Content-Security-Policy with `default-src 'self'`
  and a restrictive `Permissions-Policy`.
- Turnstile and rate limiting are optional additions, not requirements.

## Replacing the enquiry system later

Nothing about the marketing site depends on how enquiries are handled. To move
to a scheduling or client-management platform:

1. Change the form's `action` in `content/work-with-me.json` / `build.mjs`
   and remove the `data-inquiry-form` attribute so the form submits natively, or
2. Point `action` at the platform's endpoint and keep the current JS.

No page structure, styling, or content has to change, and
`functions/api/inquiry.js` can simply be deleted.

## Accessibility and performance

Targets met and checked on every page at 1440 / 1024 / 768 / 390 / 320 px:

- semantic landmarks, one `h1` per page, no skipped heading levels
- every image has `alt`, plus `width`/`height` to prevent layout shift
- visible 3px focus outline on all interactive elements; skip link
- form fields have real `<label>`s, inline errors are `role="alert"`, the
  status region is `aria-live="polite"`
- no horizontal overflow at any tested width
- respects `prefers-reduced-motion`
- one font file (34 kB), three photo widths, no render-blocking third parties
